# beebjit video test sources

Unchanged `test-video.c`, `video.c` and `COPYING` from Chris Evans' beebjit,
revision `c977309448a5622c4cecf2a29f8678d0fb3aeee8`. See `../sources.json`
for original paths and hashes. GPL-3.0; copyright attribution remains in COPYING.

VIDEO_TESTS adapts selected cases, distinguishing explicit hardware confirmation
from external assertions without such confirmation. Full mapping and limitations
are in `../../VIDEO_TESTS/PROVENANCE.md`.
